scope: Universal coefficient extension, all-shift saturation and reconstruction for Artin cubic Abelian models; internal fpqc descent and canonical-family formal groupoids; all-twist Ore cohomology; finite central four-parameter models; C1-C2 and a nonempty-open intrinsic-perfect/C3 plus proper-RHom comparison. New proofs independently read. Not a full independent audit of all retained results.

review.definition: O-marked categories retain all exact O-preserving equivalences. Standard affine Grothendieck models use coefficient-action objects; nonnoetherian bases use big QGr. Every flat cubic Abelian Artin deformation now satisfies arbitrary coefficient-base-change cubic, saturation and reconstruction conditions. Internal descent of fixed models is distinct from effective descent of categories themselves; full stackification completion remains open.
review.relative_veronese: Complete proof checked, including universal polynomial embedding, Cech intersection from P-flatness, nonreduced-base conic lifting, mu2 Isom torsor, grading-scalar sheaf quotient, and H1 versus H2 descent. An independent reading found no substantive error; section reconstruction on the conic was made explicit.
review.pointed_hom: The retained relative Hom theorem still requires C1-C4. For the finite-order four-parameter family, C1-C2 are now proved on the whole coefficient base, and C3 plus perfect RHom/base change on a nonempty open under the stated geometric-generic regularity input. The relative Serre identification (-2)[3] is not proved. No full17-parameter conclusion.
review.formal_cubic: DDL all-Artin comparison and O-marking classical 1-groupoid convention retained. Lowen Thms3.14/3.26, Yekutieli Cors7.5/11.2, and objectwise unique lifts independently checked against original sources. The main full-Abel envelope theorem uses constructed-family surjectivity directly, not prior periodicity or the stronger central-pair injectivity theorem.
review.envelope_reduction: All-degree envelope flatness is now proved for every flat Abelian Artin deformation of a smooth complex cubic threefold. Consequently the retained normal-regular cubic kernel and relative Koszul-AS5 proofs apply. This is relative AS over possibly singular Artin bases, not absolute global dimension five.
review.degree_three_obstruction: B3=R^34 direct_sum R/I and I=Fitt_34(B3) retained. Complete nilpotent sorting proof establishes degree-three flatness iff all-degree flatness for nonperiodic quadratic Z-algebras with polynomial special fibre. Independently reviewed. General Koszul deformation principle is established literature, PP Ch6 Thm7.3, not claimed new.
review.rigid_ambient_application: The O-marked four-parameter corollary uses retained rigid-ambient, finite-order THCR, PBW, low-center and regular-tails inputs. Saturation and Serre conditions are justified via the stated balanced dualizing complex and Yekutieli-Zhang local duality. The whole older rigid-ambient proof was not independently reconstructed in this review.
review.retained_results: Existing 41/37 and17/13 coefficient constructions, gcd periodicity, all-Artin envelope, square-zero obstruction and formal-ring proofs retained. The new coefficient and finite-central relative proofs were reviewed here. Unchanged calculations were not rerun and the entire older manuscript was not newly audited.
review.novelty: Known DDL/Lowen/Yekutieli/CFT/Koszul, Rains, RSV, descent and Proj inputs are separated from their concrete application. Priority of universal relative cubic models and the four-parameter categorical comparison remains unconfirmed.
review.square_zero_obstruction: Complete proof independently reviewed: Schur residual Theta=delta(q_(i+1)-q_i)=F lambda; delta^2=0 and injectivity on constant three-cochains force lambda=0. Valid for any nonzero cubic, no smoothness, with dim V>=4; written in five-variable case. General Artin I subset m^2 follows by Fitting base change. Nonlinear Jacobi corrections prevent naive higher-order induction.
review.homogeneous_quantization: CFT arXiv:math/0012228v3 §3, Thm3.1, Prop3.3 and Cor5.2(iv) checked. Finite nilpotent substitution, graph-degree preservation, alpha=Pi/2 normalization, quadraticity via split-kernel Nakayama, and central cubic regularity supplied explicitly. Full graded Hochschild/Poisson gauge classification is not assumed.
review.actual_artin_comparison: Relative Poisson functor is prorepresented by T, using lifted polarization, relative bivector/Jacobi calculations and the formal PGL slice; H0(T_X)=0 removes infinitesimal automorphisms. Yekutieli makes Ass represented by the same T. The actual constructed map has injective 20-dimensional tangent map, hence induces an invertible continuous endomorphism of T. No higher agreement of independent quantization coordinates is assumed.
review.central_pair_comparison: Construction proves surjectivity of actual central-pair-to-Ass map. Injectivity uses unique invertible bimodule polarization, section recovery and quadratic envelope. Framed ring is formal PGL24 torsor over T, with scalar stabilizer removed. Proof reordered to avoid circular dependence on graded formality classification.
review.universal_coefficients: Direct Gabriel localization for arbitrary commutative S; tails torsion verified localizing using finite degree-one generation. Flat-object Ext1 reduction, finite-length induction and fp-source filtered-colimit Hom prove universal saturation. No finite-S/noetherian-S hypothesis is hidden in this argument; small qgr is used only where Abelian.
review.coefficient_descent: Internal faithfully flat descent checked via Lazard, purity/conservativity and coaction equalizer. Exact equivalences extend uniquely by adjoint mates. Hom groupoids retain natural isomorphisms; only O-marked trivial-2-inertia models permit the stated descent after passing to isomorphism classes. Full category 2-descent is not claimed.
review.canonical_relative_formal: Evaluation at the Artin base gives an equivalence between canonical relative cubic models and all O-marked Abel deformations. Arbitrary-base saturation, reconstruction and split relative-AS complexes verified. Completion after stackification can still require global-model/effective-category-descent input.
review.universal_line_cohomology: Finite flat Ore Cech complexes commute arbitrary scalar tensor. Small-extension five-lemma proves finite free cohomology: H0 for n>=0, none for n=-1, H3 of rank h(-n-2) for n<=-2. Locally projective line objects give perfect RHom with arbitrary derived base change. This is a proof, not a numerical experiment.
review.finite_central_model: Rains Thm2.13 hypotheses checked. Reduced finite-type constant-rank commutator kernels lift central symbols; homogeneous lifts give finite graded central C. Arbitrary base change uses C_S as a central action, without claiming its injectivity or full-center base-change equality. Degree-one A makes positive-central localizations strongly graded; finite sheaf-algebra Proj model and C1 established.
review.central_universal_sections: Universal S[u,v]-freeness gives regular u^ell,v^ell on all Veronese modules, hence local cohomology H0/H1 vanishing and all-shift saturation. Even ampleness/Veronese reconstruction proved; natural transformations determined via common epimorphic covers and coherent-to-Ind extension, without falsely treating line objects as projective. C2 verified.
review.intrinsic_perfect_open: Coherent Ext localizes to all central affine charts via twist resolutions, finite Cech and filtered colimits; fg syzygy plus Baer gives chart gldim from geometric-generic tails regularity. RSV finite-central PI smoothness and direct splitting-denominator spread yield relative perfect diagonals on a nonempty base open. Diagonal resolutions imply finite base-Tor equals locally Perf after arbitrary noetherian base change. Global dg Morita smoothness is not asserted.
review.relative_rhom: Local finite-projective module Hom is an S-linear summand of finite copies of S-flat Lambda. Stacks Lem36.27.1 Tag08EV gives perfect global RHom; finite Cech proves coefficient-derived base change. Nonflat central Proj is allowed; ordinary scheme-derived pullback is not silently substituted. No relative Serre formula yet.
review.universal_degree_two_center: For the concrete B_* family, the rank12 commutator map is injective at every closed coefficient point by the retained low-center lemmas. Jacobsonness makes the rank open all of Spec P; split injectivity survives every commutative coefficient base change, including nonnoetherian rings. Full-center base change is not asserted.
